limitations.note: The patch fixed reset but also replaced both enable ternaries with procedural `if` statements, so an X or Z enable now holds the old value instead of merging the old and new values as the original and reference do.

limitations.quote: # Trace accepted transfers in a synchronous FIFO
limitations.note: The consulted note covered FIFO pointer and transfer bugs, not a RAM reset loop that skips every valid address.
